name: HUMAN_CONNECTION
description: Establishing, sustaining, or re-anchoring direct personal empathy, trust, and eye contact with the viewer.

name: VISUAL_PROOF
description: Providing authentic visual materialization of a spoken claim, physical space, or tangible spec.

name: SPATIAL_CLARITY
description: Conveying physical layout, room proportions, flow, and three-dimensional architectural relationships.

name: INFORMATION_CLARITY
description: Ensuring complex numbers, financing terms, locations, or rules are effortlessly understood.

name: EMPHASIS
description: Visually and acoustically accentuating a pivotal moment, price anchor, or game-changing benefit.

name: ATMOSPHERE
description: Building sensory mood, cozy lighting, aspirational elegance, and emotional warmth.

name: NOVELTY
description: Introducing sensory refresh, scale shift, or visual disruption to prevent feed drop-off.

name: CONTINUITY
description: Maintaining unbroken flow, narrative focus, and logical sequence across thoughts.

name: CONTEXT
description: Grounding the property in its wider geographical, urban, neighborhood, or market setting.

name: ACTION_CLARITY
description: Making the immediate next conversion step unmistakable, friction-free, and inviting.

name: VISUAL_PAYOFF
description: Delivering the visual satisfaction of seeing what was teased or promised in earlier moments.

name: PERFORMANCE_PRESERVATION
description: Protecting an exceptionally strong, emotive, or comedic presenter delivery without cutting prematurely.

name: AESTHETIC_BREATHING
description: Allowing visually stunning property frames to be contemplated without rushed cutting.
